messages:
anya: Saw weird churn on the rollout timeline: same request shows two 'degrade' flips within 2s. Console increments flip_count twice. Anybody know why? :eyes:
jeff: Likely the quota backfill path. Evaluator emits a second decision when burst tokens return. We treat them as separate events downstream.
rachel: That double-counting inflates our flip rate metric and triggers alerts. We should either fold identical decisions or mark the second as a lightweight reaffirmation.
diego: Prefer folding for the metric, but preserve the backfill reason somewhere. Idea: event.folded=true + folded_reason=quota_backfill, but still store raw for debug stream.
anya: UX ask: timeline should show one primary flip per logical decision. If there are follow-ups, show a collapsed badge that expands to reveal raw events.
jeff: Implementation sketch: evaluator adds an idempotency token: idemp = sha256(trace_id + decision_class). If same token seen within window_ms (configurable, default 5000) then mark folded=true and set folded_since to original_ts.
rachel: Ingest pipeline changes: fast-path check for idemp token. If folded -> increment fold_count metric, send folded_event to 'light' index (sampled) and write raw_event to cold storage with TTL 90d.
diego: Important: alerts and flip counters must use unfolded_counter only. We'll add a new metric unfold.flip_count and maintain backwards-compat by keeping flip_count but annotate it.
anya: Also need API change for the console: /api/rollouts/{id}/timeline should return items with fields: display_type={primary, folded}, raw_sample_link optional, fold_count. Console logic: count only primary items in flip totals.
jeff: Minimal API diff: add ?include_folded=true to endpoint to fetch expanded entries. Small BFF change.
anya: Can we sample folded raw events at 5% by default? Storage team prefers <10%.
rachel: 5% ok, but increase to 50% for first 24h after a new rollout to aid debugging. We'll encode sampling policy: if rollout_age < 24h -> rate=0.5 else rate=0.05.
diego: Tests: unit for idempotency hash collision edgecases, integration to ensure folded events don't increment alert counters.
ingest-bot: Deploy note: feature-flag 'folded-audit' ready. To stage: `/deploy jeff/folded-audit staging`.
jeff: I'll open the PR for evaluator + ingest shim. @anya can you draft the console API change and add the folded badge visual?
anya: Yup, will add a compact mock. Action items: jeff PR (evaluator + flag), rachel ingestion patch + retention/sampling, diego metrics plumbing, anya console API + mock. Will sync tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
